title: Stochastic trajectories and excursions in a double quantum dot system
summary: We investigate the trajectory-level stochastic dynamics of a double quantum dot system using the formalism of stochastic excursions. An excursion is a sub-trajectory that begins when the system leaves a chosen reference state (or more generally, a set of states)---here, the empty double dot---and ends upon its first return to it. Filtering trajectories into excursions extends full counting statistics and gives access to the correlations between thermodynamic currents and excursion durations.
